tldr: A former researcher says DeepSeek, Moonshot, MiniMax and Ant Group are running Nvidia's banned Blackwell chips. Garry Tan's open test shows the wrapper around a model decides most of its coding score. Runway released a free robot control model and Nex-AGI shipped a 321B agent model under a free licence. Shopify switched on a new standard so personal AI agents can shop on any store. Anthropic's ex-researcher says an IPO slide shows Mythos can be rebuilt for a fraction of the compute.

articles.title: Researcher says Chinese labs run Nvidia Blackwell despite export ban
articles.summary: Will DePue says forensic analysis ties DeepSeek, Moonshot, MiniMax and Ant Group to export-controlled Blackwell chips.

articles.title: 35,578 Grok-built apps were open to anyone with the link
articles.summary: Claroc found 94.7% of 37,571 live Grok apps opened with no sign-in, exposing client data and staff passwords.

articles.title: Anthropic can retrain Mythos for a fraction of the compute, says Coxon
articles.summary: Ex-researcher Jacob Coxon cites an IPO roadshow slide showing Anthropic's training algorithms speeding up.

articles.title: Garry Tan opens harness evals: rules in hooks run, unnamed skills do not
articles.summary: MIT evals fix the model and tasks and swap only the harness: five of six rivals landed within 15 points of Claude Code.

articles.title: Opus 5.5 stays the coding default as Fable 5.2 costs 2.8x per task
articles.summary: Fable 5.2 solved 82.7% of 52 coding tasks against Opus 5.5's 84.6%, at 2.8 times the cost for each solved task.

articles.title: Runway open-sources Praxis-1 as a robot control model
articles.summary: Praxis-1 turns camera frames plus a text instruction into robot movement, shipped with weights and code under Apache 2.0.

articles.title: Nex-AGI ships Nex-N2.6, a 321B agentic model under Apache 2.0
articles.summary: Built on GLM-5.3-Flash, it scores 83.0 on OSWorld against the base model's 78.0 and runs in FP8.

articles.title: MiniMax releases H3-Image, a 33B open model for 16MP output
articles.summary: A 33.1B diffusion transformer that generates roughly 16MP natively and edits from multiple references, no upscale pass.

articles.title: Poppy 1.0 goes live, and Shopify turns it on for every store
articles.summary: The Personal Agent Protocol links personal agents to company sites; Meta's Muse now looks for Poppy first.

articles.title: Claude Code adds an experimental Code Mode
articles.summary: Off by default: Claude writes JavaScript that fires several tool calls in one step instead of one call at a time.

articles.title: SenseNova Loop-9B preview reported to match Qwen 3.5 27B
articles.summary: Early testers say the 9B preview is level with a model three times its size, with roughly 15B parameters active.

articles.title: Unsloth ships dynamic v3.1 quantizations for Qwen3.8-27B
articles.summary: The update cuts memory use so Qwen3.8-27B fits smaller cards, and topped Hacker News on Saturday.
